children.translated_text: Seeing that Lord who had entered the sacrificial enclosure, the <s>Asuras</s>

children.text: jagmuḥ prabhāvataḥ kṣobhaṃ tejasā tasya niṣprabhāḥ // VamPSm_10.34 //
children.translated_text: were thrown into agitation by his power, rendered lustreless by his splendor. // VamPSm_10.34 //
The sages who were assembled there at the great sacrifice rejoiced —

children.text: vasiṣṭho gādhijo gargo anye ca munisattamāḥ // VamPSm_10.35 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Gādhija</s> (son of <s>Gādhi</s>, i.e. <s>Viśvāmitra</s>), <s>Garga</s>, and other best among sages. // VamPSm_10.35 //
<s>Bali</s> too considered his entire life to have been fruitful;

children.text: tataḥ saṃkṣobhamāpanno na kaścit kiñciduktavān // VamPSm_10.36 //
children.translated_text: then, overcome by agitation, no one uttered a word. // VamPSm_10.36 //
He worshipped the Lord of the gods of gods individually with splendor;

children.text: athāsurapati prahvaṃ dṛṣṭvā munivarāśca tān // VamPSm_10.37 //
children.translated_text: then the lord of the <s>Asuras</s>, seeing the best of sages bowing, // VamPSm_10.37 //
the Lord of the gods of gods, <s>Viṣṇu</s> himself, bearing the form of a dwarf,
praised the sacrifice, the fire, and the sacrificer, and being worshipped,
praised those authorized for the sacrificial rites, the assembly members, and the wealth of materials. // VamPSm_10.38 //
The assembly members, recognizing <s>Vāmana</s> as the complete worthy recipient,
standing in the sacrificial enclosure — O <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, they exclaimed 'Well done! Well done!' // VamPSm_10.39 //
<s>Bali</s>, taking the offering of <s>arghya</s> (respectful oblation), his hair standing on end with joy,

children.text: pūjayāmāsa govindaṃ prāha cedaṃ mahāsuraḥ // VamPSm_10.40 //
children.translated_text: worshipped <s>Govinda</s> and the great <s>Asura</s> spoke thus: // VamPSm_10.40 //
<s>Bali</s> said:
Heaps of gold and gems, hosts of elephants and horses,

children.text: striyo vastrāṇyalaṅkārān gāvo grāmāśca puṣkalāḥ // VamPSm_10.41 //
children.translated_text: women, garments, ornaments, cows, and abundant villages — // VamPSm_10.41 //

children.text: sarve ca saralā pṛthvī bhavato vā yadīpsitam /
children.translated_text: all these and the entire earth — or whatever you desire,

children.text: tad dadāsi vṛṇuṣveṣṭaṃ mamārthāḥ santi te priyāḥ // VamPSm_10.42 //
children.translated_text: I shall give; choose what you wish — my possessions are dear to you. // VamPSm_10.42 //
Thus addressed by the lord of the <s>Daityas</s> with words filled with affection,
the Blessed Lord in the form of <s>Vāmana</s> spoke with a gentle smile, deep-voiced: // VamPSm_10.43 //
For the sake of my fire-shelter, O king, give me three paces of land;
gold, villages, gems and the like — let those be given to other supplicants. // VamPSm_10.44 //
<s>Bali</s> said:

children.text: tribhiḥ prayojanaṃ kiṃ te padaiḥ padavatāṃ vara /
children.translated_text: What use are three paces to you, O best among those who possess feet?

children.text: śataṃ śatasahasraṃ vā padānāṃ mārgatāṃ bhavān // VamPSm_10.45 //
children.translated_text: Take a hundred, or a hundred thousand paces! // VamPSm_10.45 //
Śrī <s>Vāmana</s> said:
With just this much, O lord of the <s>Daityas</s>, I am fulfilled as a supplicant;
you will give wealth to other seekers according to their desire. // VamPSm_10.46 //
Having heard the words spoken by the great-souled <s>Vāmana</s>,

children.text: vācayāmāsa vai tasmai vāmanāya mahātmane // VamPSm_10.47 //
children.translated_text: he had the ritual recitation performed for that great-souled <s>Vāmana</s>. // VamPSm_10.47 //
When the water fell upon his hand, <s>Vāmana</s> became 'not-dwarf' (i.e., gigantic);
he revealed his form comprising all the gods at that very instant. // VamPSm_10.48 //

children.text: cantrasūryau tu nayane dyauḥ śiraścaraṇau kṣitiḥ /
children.translated_text: The moon and sun were his eyes, heaven was his head, and the earth his feet;
<s>Piśācas</s> were his toes, and <s>Guhyakas</s> were his fingers. // VamPSm_10.49 //
The <s>Viśvedevas</s> were stationed at his knees, the <s>Sādhyas</s>, best of gods, at his shanks;
<s>Yakṣas</s> were born in his nails, and <s>Apsarases</s> in the lines of his palms. // VamPSm_10.50 //
His gaze comprised all the constellations (<s>nakṣatras</s>), the Lord's hair was the rays of the sun;

children.text: tārakā romakūpāṇi romeṣu ca maharṣayaḥ // VamPSm_10.51 //
children.translated_text: the stars were his pores, and the great sages (<s>Maharṣis</s>) dwelt in his body hair. // VamPSm_10.51 //
His arms were the intermediate directions, and the ears of the great-souled one were the cardinal directions;

children.text: aśvinau śravaṇe tasya nāsā vāyurmahātmanaḥ // VamPSm_10.52 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Aśvins</s> were in his hearing, and the wind (<s>Vāyu</s>) was the nose of the great-souled one. // VamPSm_10.52 //

children.text: prasāde candramā devo mano dharmaḥ samāśritaḥ /
children.translated_text: The moon god was in his grace, <s>Dharma</s> (righteousness) resided in his mind;

children.text: satyamasyābhavad vāṇī jihvā devī sarasvatī // VamPSm_10.53 //
children.translated_text: truth became his speech, and goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> was his tongue. // VamPSm_10.53 //
<s>Aditi</s>, mother of the gods, was his neck; the sciences were his bracelets;

children.text: svargadvāramabhūnmaitraṃ tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca vai bhruvau // VamPSm_10.54 //
children.translated_text: the gateway to heaven became friendliness (<s>Maitra</s>); <s>Tvaṣṭā</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> were his eyebrows. // VamPSm_10.54 //
<s>Vaiśvānara</s> (the universal fire) was in his mouth; <s>Prajāpati</s> was his testicles;

children.text: hṛdayaṃ ca paraṃ brahma puṃstvaṃ vai kaśyapo muniḥ // VamPSm_10.55 //
children.translated_text: the supreme <s>Brahman</s> was his heart; and the sage <s>Kaśyapa</s> was his manhood. // VamPSm_10.55 //
The <s>Vasus</s> were on his back, and the <s>Maruts</s> in all his joints;

children.text: vakṣasthale tathā rudro dhairye cāsya mahārṇavaḥ // VamPSm_10.56 //
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> was on his chest, and the great ocean was his steadfastness. // VamPSm_10.56 //
In his belly were the <s>Gandharvas</s> and the mighty <s>Maruts</s>;

children.text: lakṣmīrmedhā dhṛtiḥ kāntiḥ sarvavidyāśca vai kaṭiḥ // VamPSm_10.57 //
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Medhā</s> (intellect), <s>Dhṛti</s> (fortitude), <s>Kānti</s> (radiance), and all the sciences were his waist. // VamPSm_10.57 //
All the luminaries that exist here, and the supreme, great <s>tapas</s> (austerity) —
these were the sublime splendor that arose from that god of gods. // VamPSm_10.58 //

children.text: tanau kukṣiṣu vedāśca jānunī ca mahāmakhāḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vedas</s> were in his body and flanks, the great sacrifices were his knees;

children.text: iṣṭayaḥ paśavaścāsya dvijānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca // VamPSm_10.59 //
children.translated_text: the ritual offerings and sacrificial animals were his, as were the observances of the twice-born. // VamPSm_10.59 //
Seeing that divine form of the great-souled <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: upasarpanti te daityāḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam // VamPSm_10.60 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Daityas</s> rushed toward him like moths into a fire. // VamPSm_10.60 //
The great <s>Daitya</s> <s>Cikṣura</s> seized his big toe;
<s>Hari</s> struck his neck with his teeth and crushed him with his thumb. // VamPSm_10.61 //
The all-pervading Lord, crushing all the <s>Asuras</s> with the soles of his feet and hands,

children.text: kṛtvā rūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ saṃjahārāśu medinīm // VamPSm_10.62 //
children.translated_text: assuming a form of immense size, swiftly reclaimed the earth. // VamPSm_10.62 //
As he strode across the earth, the moon and sun were between his breasts;
as he strode across the sky, both were stationed at his thigh region. // VamPSm_10.63 //
As he took the supreme stride, the two luminaries were at the base of his knee;
thus stood <s>Viṣṇu</s>, engaged in the task of protecting the gods. // VamPSm_10.64 //
Having conquered the three worlds and slain the foremost <s>Asuras</s>,
<s>Viṣṇu</s> of great strides (<s>Urukrama</s>) gave the three worlds to <s>Purandara</s> (<s>Indra</s>). // VamPSm_10.65 //
The <s>Pātāla</s> realm named <s>Sutala</s>, beneath the surface of the earth,
was given to <s>Bali</s> by the mighty Lord <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // VamPSm_10.66 //
Then <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Lord of all lords, spoke to the lord of the <s>Daityas</s>:

children.text: yat tvayā salilaṃ dattaṃ gṛhītaṃ pāṇinā mayā // VamPSm_10.67 //
children.translated_text: 'Since the water-offering was given by you and received by my hand, // VamPSm_10.67 //
therefore your lifespan shall be of the measure of a <s>kalpa</s> (aeon), supremely excellent;

children.text: vaivakhate tathātīte kāle manvantare tathā // VamPSm_10.68 //
children.translated_text: and when the <s>Vaivasvata</s> (<s>Manvantara</s>) has passed, in that era, // VamPSm_10.68 //
when the <s>Sāvarṇika</s> (<s>Manvantara</s>) arrives, you shall become <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: idānīṃ bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ dattaṃ śakrāya vai purā // VamPSm_10.69 //
children.translated_text: For now, the entire world has been given to <s>Śakra</s> (<s>Indra</s>) as before. // VamPSm_10.69 //
The arrangement of the four <s>Yugas</s>, numbering seventy-one and more,

children.text: niyantavyā mayā sarve ye tasya paripanthinaḥ // VamPSm_10.70 //
children.translated_text: and all those who oppose him — they are to be restrained by me. // VamPSm_10.70 //
By you I was formerly worshipped with supreme devotion, O <s>Bali</s>;

children.text: sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ samāsādya vaco mama // VamPSm_10.71 //
children.translated_text: therefore, reaching the <s>Pātāla</s> realm named <s>Sutala</s>, heed my words: // VamPSm_10.71 //
Dwell there, O <s>Asura</s>, faithfully carrying out my command,
in that place endowed with divine comforts, filled with hundreds of palaces, // VamPSm_10.72 //
with lakes full of blooming lotuses, with pure and excellent rivers,
fragrant, abundantly supplied with food, adorned with the finest ornaments, // VamPSm_10.73 //
your limbs anointed with garlands, sandalwood, and the like, enjoying
various magnificent pleasures, delightful with dance and song, O lord of the <s>Dānavas</s>! // VamPSm_10.74 //
By my command, remain for this period of time, attended by hundreds of women,

children.text: yāvatsuraiśca vipraiśca na virodhaṃ gamiṣyasi // VamPSm_10.75 //
children.translated_text: as long as you do not enter into conflict with the gods and the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>. // VamPSm_10.75 //
Until then, enjoy all pleasures endowed with every desire;

children.text: yadā suraiśca vipraiśca virodhaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi /
children.translated_text: but when you enter into conflict with the gods and the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,

children.text: bandhiṣyanti tadā pāsā vāruṇā ghoradarśanāḥ // VamPSm_10.76 //
children.translated_text: then the terrible-looking bonds of <s>Varuṇa</s> shall bind you.' // VamPSm_10.76 //
<s>Bali</s> said:
'While I dwell in <s>Pātāla</s> by your command, O Blessed Lord,
what shall be my sustenance, the means of my enjoyment,

children.text: āpyāyito yena deva smareyaṃ tvāmahaṃ sadā // VamPSm_10.77 //
children.translated_text: nourished by which, O Lord, I may always remember you?' // VamPSm_10.77 //
The Blessed Lord said:
'Gifts given without proper ritual procedure, <s>śrāddhas</s> (ancestral rites) performed without learned <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,

children.text: hutānyaśraddhayā yāni tāni dāsyanti te phalam // VamPSm_10.78 //
children.translated_text: and offerings made without faith — these shall yield their fruit to you. // VamPSm_10.78 //
Sacrifices performed without <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (priestly fees), and rites performed without proper procedure,

children.text: phalāni tava dāsyanti adhītānyavratāni ca // VamPSm_10.79 //
children.translated_text: shall yield their fruits to you, as shall studies undertaken without vows. // VamPSm_10.79 //

children.text: udakena vinā pūjā vinā darbeṇa yā kriyā /
children.translated_text: Worship performed without water, rites performed without <s>darbha</s> grass,

children.text: ājyena ca vinā homaṃ phalaṃ dāsyanti te bale // VamPSm_10.80 //
children.translated_text: and <s>homa</s> (fire offerings) performed without ghee — these shall yield their fruit to you, O <s>Bali</s>. // VamPSm_10.80 //
But whoever performs any rites having resorted to this sacred place,

children.text: na tatra cāsuro bhāgo bhaviṣyati kadācana // VamPSm_10.81 //
children.translated_text: there shall never be any share for the <s>Asuras</s> in that. // VamPSm_10.81 //
At the greatly meritorious <s>Jyeṣṭhāśrama</s>, and at the lake called <s>Viṣṇupada</s>,

children.text: ye ca śrāddhāni dāsyanti vrataṃ niyamameva ca // VamPSm_10.82 //
children.translated_text: those who perform <s>śrāddhas</s>, undertake vows and observances, // VamPSm_10.82 //

children.text: kriyā kṛtā ca yā kācid vidhināvidhināpi vā /
children.translated_text: any rite performed there, whether with proper procedure or without —

children.text: sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_10.83 //
children.translated_text: all that shall become imperishable for that person, without doubt. // VamPSm_10.83 //
In the month of <s>Jyeṣṭha</s>, in the bright fortnight, having fasted on the eleventh day (<s>Ekādaśī</s>),

children.text: dvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā viṣṇupade hvade /
children.translated_text: on the twelfth day (<s>Dvādaśī</s>), having beheld <s>Vāmana</s> and bathed at the <s>Viṣṇupada</s> lake,

children.text: dānaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_10.84 //
children.translated_text: having given gifts according to one's ability, one attains the supreme abode.' // VamPSm_10.84 //
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
Having given this boon to <s>Bali</s> and heaven (<s>Triviṣṭapa</s>) to <s>Śakra</s> (<s>Indra</s>),

children.text: vyāpinā tena rūpeṇa jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ // VamPSm_10.85 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s>, with that all-pervading form, disappeared from sight. // VamPSm_10.85 //
<s>Indra</s> ruled the three worlds as before, with great power;

children.text: niḥśeṣaṃ ca tadā kālaṃ baliḥ pātālamāsthitaḥ // VamPSm_10.86 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Bali</s> remained in <s>Pātāla</s> for the remaining time. // VamPSm_10.86 //
Thus has been narrated the supreme glory of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: vāmanasya śṛṇvan yastu sarvapāṣaiḥ pramucyate // VamPSm_10.87 //
children.translated_text: of <s>Vāmana</s> — whoever hears it is freed from all bonds. // VamPSm_10.87 //
The dialogue between <s>Bali</s> and <s>Prahlāda</s>, the counsel of <s>Bali</s> and <s>Śukra</s>,

children.text: balerviṣṇośca caritaṃ ye smariṣyanti mānavāḥ // VamPSm_10.88 //
children.translated_text: and the deeds of <s>Bali</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s> — those mortals who remember them, // VamPSm_10.88 //

children.text: nādhayo vyādhayasteṣāṃ na ca mohākulaṃ manaḥ /
children.translated_text: for them there shall be no afflictions of mind or body, nor a mind overwhelmed by delusion —
this shall never befall such a person, O best of the twice-born! // VamPSm_10.89 //
One who has lost a kingdom regains his own kingdom; one separated from the beloved attains reunion;

children.text: samāpneti mahābhāgā naraḥ śrutvā kathāmimām // VamPSm_10.90 //
children.translated_text: a person attains these, O greatly fortunate ones, by hearing this story. // VamPSm_10.90 //
A <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> attains the <s>Vedas</s>, a <s>Kṣatriya</s> conquers the earth,
a <s>Vaiśya</s> attains abundance of wealth, and a <s>Śūdra</s> obtains happiness;

children.text: vāmanasya ca māhatmyaṃ śṛṇvan pāpaiḥ pramucyate // VamPSm_10.91 //
children.translated_text: whoever hears the glory of <s>Vāmana</s> is freed from sins. // VamPSm_10.91 //
Thus ends the tenth chapter in the Saromāhātmya of the Śrī <s>Vāmana Purāṇa</s>.
The sages said:
'How did this river, the best of rivers, originate —
the greatly fortunate <s>Sakakhatī</s>, flowing through <s>Kurukṣetra</s>? // VamPSm_11.1 //

children.text: kathaṃ saraḥ samāsādya kṛtvā tīrthāni pārśvataḥ /
children.translated_text: How did she, reaching the lake and creating sacred sites (<s>tīrthas</s>) on its sides,
proceed toward the western direction, auspicious, with her course visible and invisible?

children.text: etad vistarato brūhi tīrthaṃvaṃśaṃ sanātanam // VamPSm_11.2 //
children.translated_text: Tell us this in detail — the ancient lineage of the sacred site.' // VamPSm_11.2 //
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
'Arising from the <s>Plakṣa</s> tree, the best of rivers, eternal,
She destroys all sins merely by being remembered constantly. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.3 //
That great river, having split through thousands of mountains,

children.text: praviṣṭā puṇyatoyaughā vanaṃ dvaitamiti smṛtam // VamPSm_11.4 //
children.translated_text: entered with her sacred waters into the forest known as <s>Dvaita</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.4 //

children.text: tasmin palkṣe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ /
children.translated_text: Seeing her stationed at that <s>Plakṣa</s> (fig tree), the great sage <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>,

children.text: praṇipatya tadā mūrdhnā tuṣṭāvātha sarasvatīm // VamPSm_11.5 //
children.translated_text: having bowed his head, then praised <s>Sarasvatī</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.5 //

children.text: tvaṃ devi sarvalokānāṃ mātā devāraṇiḥ śubhā /
children.translated_text: O <s>Devī</s>, you are the mother of all worlds, the auspicious fire-churning stick (<s>araṇi</s>) of the gods.
O <s>Devī</s>, whatever is existent and non-existent, whatever is meaningful and grants liberation,

children.text: tat sarvaṃ tvayi saṃyogi yogivad devi saṃsthitam /
children.translated_text: all that is united with you, O <s>Devī</s>, abiding like a yogin.

children.text: akṣaraṃ paramaṃ devī yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam /
children.translated_text: The supreme imperishable <s>Devī</s>, in whom everything is established,

children.text: akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma viśvaṃ caitat kṣarātmakam // VamPSm_11.7 //
children.translated_text: the supreme imperishable <s>Brahman</s> — and this universe is of a perishable nature. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.7 //
Just as fire abides in wood and fragrance in the earth permanently,

children.text: tathā tvayi sthitaṃ brahma jagaccedamaśeṣataḥ // VamPSm_11.8 //
children.translated_text: so too <s>Brahman</s> and this entire world abide in you. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.8 //
O <s>Devī</s>, that which has the form of the syllable <s>Oṃ</s>, both stable and unstable,

children.text: tatra mātrātrayaṃ sarvamasti yad devi nāsti ca // VamPSm_11.9 //
children.translated_text: therein are the three <s>mātrās</s> (measures) — all that exists and does not exist, O <s>Devī</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.9 //
The three worlds, the three <s>Vedas</s>, the threefold knowledge, the three fires,

children.text: trīṇi jyotīṃṣi vargāśca trayo dharmādayastathā // VamPSm_11.10 //
children.translated_text: the three luminaries, the three groups, the three [goals] beginning with <s>dharma</s>, // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.10 //
the three <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), the three <s>varṇas</s> (classes), the three gods in order,
the three constituent elements, the three states, the ancestors, and so forth. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.11 //
This triad of <s>mātrās</s>, O <s>Devī</s>, is your form, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>,
the primordial one of <s>Brahman</s>, the eternal one, [seen] through the various philosophical views. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.12 //
The <s>Somasaṃsthā</s> (Soma rituals), the <s>Haviḥsaṃsthā</s> (oblation rituals), the <s>Pākasaṃsthā</s> (cooked offering rituals) — eternal,
these, O <s>Devī</s>, are performed by the expounders of <s>Brahman</s> through your utterance. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.13 //
But this supreme [reality], beyond designation, resting in the half-measure (<s>ardhamātrā</s>),
divine, immutable, imperishable, free from transformation, // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.14 //

children.text: tavaitat paramaṃ rūpaṃ yanna śakyaṃ mayoditum /
children.translated_text: this is your supreme form, which cannot be described by me;

children.text: na cāsyena na vā jihvātālvoṣṭhādibhirucyate // VamPSm_11.15 //
children.translated_text: it is not uttered by the mouth, nor by the tongue, palate, lips, and the like. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.15 //

children.text: sa viṣṇuḥ sa vṛṣo brahma candrākrajyotireva ca /
children.translated_text: He is <s>Viṣṇu</s>, He is the Bull (<s>Vṛṣa</s>), He is <s>Brahma</s>, the light of the moon, sun, and fire,
the all-pervading <s>Viśvāvāsa</s>, the universal form, the universal self, the masterless one. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.16 //
Proclaimed by <s>Sāṅkhya</s> doctrine and the <s>Vedas</s>, established through many branches,
without beginning, middle, or end, both existent and non-existent, yet truly existent. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.17 //
One, yet also manifold, resting on the unity of being and knowledge,

children.text: anākhyaṃ ṣaḍguṇākhyaṃ ca bahvākhyaṃ triguṇāśrayam // VamPSm_11.18 //
children.translated_text: unnameable, yet called the six-attributed one, and called by many names, the support of the three <s>guṇas</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.18 //
The knower of the manifestations of various powers, the manifester of various powers,

children.text: sukhāt sukhaṃ mahātsaukhyaṃ rūpaṃ tattvaguṇātmakam // VamPSm_11.19 //
children.translated_text: from bliss arises bliss, the great felicity — a form whose essence is truth and quality. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.19 //

children.text: evaṃ devi tvayā vyāptaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat /
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Devī</s>, by you is pervaded all that is with parts and without parts,

children.text: advaitāvasthitaṃ brahma yacca dvaite vyavasthitam // VamPSm_11.20 //
children.translated_text: <s>Brahman</s> that abides in non-duality and that which is established in duality. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.20 //

children.text: ye'rthā nityā ye vinaśyanti cānye ye'rthāḥ sthūlā ye tathā santi sūkṣmāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those things that are eternal and those others that perish, those things that are gross and those that are subtle,

children.text: ye vā bhūmau ye 'ntarikṣenyato vā teṣāṃ devi tvatta evopalabdhiḥ // VamPSm_11.21 //
children.translated_text: those on earth, those in the atmosphere, or from anywhere — O <s>Devī</s>, their apprehension comes from you alone. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.21 //

children.text: yadvā mūrtaṃ yadamūrtaṃ samastaṃ yadvā bhūteṣvekamekaṃ ca kiñcit /
children.translated_text: Whatever is corporeal and whatever is incorporeal in its totality, whatever is one and singular among beings,

children.text: yacca dvaite vyastabhūtaṃ ca lakṣyaṃ tatsaṃbaddhaṃ tvatsvarairvyañjanaiśca // VamPSm_11.22 //
children.translated_text: and whatever is manifest as separate elements in duality — all that is connected with your vowels and consonants. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.22 //

children.text: evaṃ stutā tadā devī viṣṇorjihvā sarasvatī /
children.translated_text: Thus praised, the <s>Devī</s> <s>Sarasvatī</s>, the tongue of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,
replied to the great-souled sage <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>:

children.text: yatra tvaṃ neṣyase vipra tatra yāsyāmyatandritā // VamPSm_11.23 //
children.translated_text: 'Wherever you shall lead me, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, there I shall go without delay.' // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.23 //
<s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> said:

children.text: ādyaṃ brahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ tato rāmahvadaḥ smṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: First there is the sacred <s>Brahmasaras</s> (lake of <s>Brahmā</s>), then the one called <s>Rāmahrada</s>,

children.text: kuruṇā ṛṣiṇā puṣṭaṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ smṛtam /
children.translated_text: nurtured by the sage <s>Kuru</s> — hence it is known as <s>Kurukṣetra</s>;

children.text: tasya madhyena vai gāḍhaṃ puṇyā puṇyajalāvahā // VamPSm_11.24 //
children.translated_text: through its middle flows deep the sacred one, bearing holy waters. // <s>VamPSm</s> 11.24 //
Thus ends the eleventh chapter of the <s>Saromāhātmya</s> in the <s>Vāmana Purāṇa</s>.
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
Having heard the words of the wise <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>,

children.text: nadī pravāhasaṃyuktā kurukṣetraṃ viveśa ha // VamPSm_12.1 //
children.translated_text: the river, joined with her flow, entered <s>Kurukṣetra</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.1 //

children.text: tatra sā rantukaṃ prāpya puṇyatoyā sarasvatī /
children.translated_text: There, the sacred-watered <s>Sarasvatī</s>, having reached <s>Rantuka</s>,

children.text: kurakṣetraṃ samāplāvya prayātā paścimāṃ diśam // VamPSm_12.2 //
children.translated_text: having flooded <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, proceeded toward the western direction. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.2 //

children.text: tatra tīrthasahasrāṇi ṛṣibhiḥ sevitāni ca/ tānyahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ // VamPSm_12.3 //
children.translated_text: There are thousands of <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred fords) frequented by <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages); I shall enumerate them by the grace of <s>Parameṣṭhin</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>). // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.3 //
The remembrance of <s>tīrthas</s> is meritorious, their sight destroys sins,
and bathing [in them] is said to grant liberation, even for one who has committed wicked deeds. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.4 //

children.text: ye smaranti ca tīrthāni devatāḥ prīṇayanti ca /
children.translated_text: Those who remember the <s>tīrthas</s> and gratify the deities,

children.text: snānti ca śraddadhānāśca te yānti paramāṃ gatim // VamPSm_12.5 //
children.translated_text: and who bathe with faith — they attain the supreme destination. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.5 //

children.text: apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato 'pi vā /
children.translated_text: Whether impure or pure, or in whatever state one may be,

children.text: yaḥ smaret kurukṣetraṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ // VamPSm_12.6 //
children.translated_text: whoever remembers <s>Kurukṣetra</s> becomes pure both externally and internally. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.6 //
'I shall go to <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, I shall dwell in <s>Kurukṣetra</s>' —
by merely uttering such words, one is freed from all sins. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.7 //
Knowledge of <s>Brahman</s>, <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) at <s>Gayā</s>, death during a cattle raid,

children.text: vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ kurukṣetre muktiruktā caturvidhā // VamPSm_12.8 //
children.translated_text: and dwelling in <s>Kurukṣetra</s> for people — these are declared to be the four kinds of liberation. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.8 //
The land between the divine rivers <s>Sarasvatī</s> and <s>Dṛṣadvatī</s>,

children.text: taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmavartaṃ pracakṣate // VamPSm_12.9 //
children.translated_text: that divinely created region is called <s>Brahmāvarta</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.9 //
'Though far away, I shall go to <s>Kurukṣetra</s> and dwell there' —

children.text: evaṃ yaḥ satataṃ brūyāt so 'pi pāṣaiḥ pramucyate // VamPSm_12.10 //
children.translated_text: whoever constantly says thus is also freed from sins. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.10 //
And one who bathes in the lake there, standing on the bank of <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: tasya jñānaṃ brahmamayamutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_12.11 //
children.translated_text: in him shall arise knowledge full of <s>Brahman</s> — there is no doubt. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.11 //
Deities, sages, and <s>Siddhas</s> (perfected beings) frequent <s>Kurujāṅgala</s>;

children.text: tasya saṃsevanānnityaṃ brahma cātmani paśyati // VamPSm_12.12 //
children.translated_text: by constantly attending upon that [place], one sees <s>Brahman</s> within oneself. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.12 //

children.text: cañcalaṃ hi manuṣyatvaṃ prāpya ye mokṣakāṅkiṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having obtained the fleeting state of human existence, those who desire liberation,
self-controlled, worship [there], even those who have committed misdeeds. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.13 //
They, freed from impurities arising from many births,

children.text: paśyanti nirmalaṃ devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ sanātanam // VamPSm_12.14 //
children.translated_text: behold the eternal, immaculate god dwelling in the heart. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.14 //

children.text: brahmavediḥ kurukṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihitaṃ saraḥ // VamPSm_12.15 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kurukṣetra</s> is the altar of <s>Brahmā</s>; the sacred lake is <s>Sānnihita</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.15 //
For planets, constellations, and stars, there is the fear of falling with time;

children.text: kurukṣetre mṛtānāṃ ca patanaṃ naiva vidyate // VamPSm_12.16 //
children.translated_text: but for those who die in <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, there is no falling at all. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.16 //
Where <s>Brahmā</s> and the other gods, sages, <s>Siddhas</s>, <s>Cāraṇas</s> (celestial bards),
<s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Apsarases</s>, and <s>Yakṣas</s> attend, desiring a [permanent] abode. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.17 //

children.text: gatvā tu śraddhāyā yuktaḥ snātvā sthāṇumahāhvade /
children.translated_text: Having gone there with faith, having bathed at <s>Sthāṇu-Mahāhvada</s>,

children.text: manasā cintitaṃ kāmaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_12.18 //
children.translated_text: one obtains the desire conceived in the mind — there is no doubt. // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.18 //

children.text: niyamaṃ ta tataḥ kṛtvā gatvā saraḥ pradakṣiṇam /
children.translated_text: Then, having taken a vow, having circumambulated the lake,

children.text: rantukaṃ ca samāsādya kṣamayitvā punaḥ punaḥ // VamPSm_12.19 //
children.translated_text: and having reached <s>Rantuka</s>, seeking forgiveness again and again, // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.19 //

children.text: sarasvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca /
children.translated_text: having bathed in <s>Sarasvatī</s>, having seen and bowed to the <s>Yakṣa</s>,

children.text: puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca naivaidyaṃ datvā vācamudīrayet // VamPSm_12.20 //
children.translated_text: having offered flowers, incense, and food offerings, one should utter [these] words: // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.20 //

children.text: tava prasādād yakṣendra vānāni saritaśca yāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'By your grace, O lord of <s>Yakṣas</s>, the forests and the rivers —

children.text: bhramiṣyāmi ca tīrthāni avighneṃ kuru me sadā // VamPSm_12.21 //
children.translated_text: I shall wander among the <s>tīrthas</s>; make [my journey] always free from obstacles.' // <s>VamPSm</s> 12.21 //
Thus ends the twelfth chapter of the <s>Saromāhātmya</s> in the <s>Vāmana Purāṇa</s>.
The sages said:

children.text: vanāni sapta no brūhi nava nadyaśca yāḥ smṛtāḥ /
children.translated_text: Tell us the seven forests and the nine rivers that are mentioned,

children.text: tīrthāni ca samagrāṇi tīrthasnānaphalaṃ tathā // VamPSm_13.1 //
children.translated_text: and all the <s>tīrthas</s> together, and the fruit of bathing at the <s>tīrthas</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.1 //

children.text: yena yena vidhānena yasya tīrthasya yat phalam /
children.translated_text: By which procedure, for which <s>tīrtha</s>, what is the fruit —

children.text: tat sarvaṃ vistateṇeha brūhi paurāṇikottama // VamPSm_13.2 //
children.translated_text: tell all that in detail here, O best of <s>Paurāṇikas</s> (narrators of <s>Purāṇas</s>). // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.2 //
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
Hear of the seven forests in the midst of <s>Kurukṣetra</s>,

children.text: yeṣāṃ nāmāni puṇyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca // VamPSm_13.3 //
children.translated_text: whose names are sacred and destroy all sins. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.3 //

children.text: kāmyakaṃ ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ tathāditivanaṃ mahat /
children.translated_text: The sacred <s>Kāmyaka</s> forest, and the great <s>Aditi</s> forest,

children.text: vyāsasya ca vanaṃ puṇyaṃ phalakīvanameva ca // VamPSm_13.4 //
children.translated_text: the sacred forest of <s>Vyāsa</s>, and <s>Phalakīvana</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.4 //
There the <s>Sūryavana</s> (Sun forest), and the great <s>Madhuvana</s> (Honey forest),
and the sacred <s>Śītavana</s> (Cool forest), which destroys all impurities. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.5 //

children.text: vanānyetāni vai sapta nadīḥ śṛṇuta me dvijāḥ /
children.translated_text: These are the seven forests; now hear from me the rivers, O <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.

children.text: sarasvatī nadī puṇyā tathā vaitaraṇī nadī // VamPSm_13.6 //
children.translated_text: The sacred river <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and the river <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>, // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.6 //

children.text: āpagā ca mahāpuṇyā gaṅgā mandākinī nadī /
children.translated_text: the greatly sacred <s>Āpagā</s>, the river <s>Gaṅgā Mandākinī</s>,
<s>Madhusrāvā</s>, <s>Vāsunadī</s>, and the sin-destroying <s>Kauśikī</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.7 //
The greatly sacred <s>Dṛṣadvatī</s>, and the river <s>Hiraṇvatī</s> —
all flow during the rainy season, except <s>Sarasvatī</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.8 //
The water of these is declared sacred during the rainy season;
there is never any impurity in them,

children.text: tīrthasya ca prabhāveṇa puṇyā hyetāḥ saridvarāḥ // VamPSm_13.9 //
children.translated_text: and by the power of the <s>tīrthas</s>, these excellent rivers are holy. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.9 //
Hear, O delighted sages, the fruit of bathing at <s>tīrthas</s> together —
the going and the remembrance [of <s>tīrthas</s>] destroy all impurities. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.10 //

children.text: rantukaṃ ca naro dṛṣṭvā dvārapālaṃ mahābalam /
children.translated_text: Having seen <s>Rantuka</s>, the mighty guardian of the gate,
having saluted the <s>Yakṣa</s>, one should undertake the pilgrimage to the <s>tīrthas</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.11 //
Then, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, one should go to the great forest called <s>Aditivana</s>,

children.text: adityā yatra gutrārthaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahattapaḥ // VamPSm_13.12 //
children.translated_text: where <s>Aditi</s> performed fierce and great <s>tapas</s> (austerity) for the sake of a son. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.12 //

children.text: tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca aditiṃ devamātaram /
children.translated_text: Having bathed and seen <s>Aditi</s>, the mother of the gods,
one begets a heroic son, free from all faults,
and ascends a celestial vehicle resplendent like a hundred <s>Ādityas</s> (suns). // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.13 //
Then, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, one should go to the supreme abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: savanaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ yatra saṃnihito hariḥ // VamPSm_13.14 //
children.translated_text: the famous place called <s>Savana</s>, where <s>Hari</s> is present. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.14 //

children.text: vimale ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vimaleśvaram /
children.translated_text: Having bathed at <s>Vimala</s> and seen <s>Vimaleśvara</s>,

children.text: nirmalaṃ svargamāyāti rudralokaṃ ca gacchati // VamPSm_13.15 //
children.translated_text: one attains the spotless heaven and goes to the world of <s>Rudra</s>. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.15 //
Having seen <s>Hari</s> and <s>Baladeva</s>, seated together in one place,
one attains liberation from the impurities born of the <s>Kali</s> age. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.16 //
Then one should go to <s>Pāriplava</s>, the <s>tīrtha</s> renowned in the three worlds;

children.text: tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ vedasaṃyutam // VamPSm_13.17 //
children.translated_text: having bathed there and seen <s>Brahmā</s> accompanied by the <s>Vedas</s>, // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.17 //
having obtained the fruit of [knowing] the <s>Brahma-Veda</s>, one attains the spotless heaven.
There also, having reached the confluence born of a <s>tīrtha</s> on the <s>Kauśikī</s>,

children.text: saṃgame ca naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_13.18 //
children.translated_text: and having bathed at the confluence, a person attains the supreme state. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.18 //
Having reached the <s>tīrtha</s> of <s>Dharaṇī</s> (Earth), which liberates from all sins,

children.text: kṣāntiyukto naraḥ snātvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_13.19 //
children.translated_text: a person endowed with patience, having bathed, attains the supreme state. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.19 //
The offenses committed by a person against the earth,

children.text: sarvāṇi kṣamate tasya snātamātrasya dehinaḥ // VamPSm_13.20 //
children.translated_text: all those are forgiven for the embodied one who has merely bathed. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.20 //

children.text: tato dakṣāśramaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā dekṣeśvaraṃ śivam /
children.translated_text: Then, having gone to the hermitage of <s>Dakṣa</s> and seen <s>Dakṣeśvara Śiva</s>,

children.text: aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ // VamPSm_13.21 //
children.translated_text: a person obtains the fruit of the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice). // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.21 //

children.text: tataḥ śālūkinīṃ gatvā snātvā tīrthe dvijottamāḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, having gone to <s>Śālūkinī</s> and bathed at the <s>tīrtha</s>, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,
having worshipped <s>Hari</s> united with <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), endowed with devotion,
one attains the imperishable worlds, free from all sins. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.22 //
Having reached <s>Sarpirdadhi</s>, the supreme <s>tīrtha</s> of the <s>Nāgas</s> (serpents),

children.text: tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā mukto nāgabhayād bhavet // VamPSm_13.23 //
children.translated_text: a person, having bathed there, becomes freed from the fear of serpents. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.23 //

children.text: tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam /
children.translated_text: Then, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, one should go to the gate-guardian <s>Rantuka</s>;

children.text: tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ snātvā tīrthavare śubhe // VamPSm_13.24 //
children.translated_text: having stayed there one night and bathed at that excellent holy <s>tīrtha</s>, // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.24 //
one should worship the second gate-guardian with effort there,

children.text: brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet // VamPSm_13.25 //
children.translated_text: and having fed <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, bowing and seeking forgiveness. // <s>VamPSm</s> 13.25 //

children.text: tava prasādād yakṣendra mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ /
children.translated_text: By your grace, O lord of <s>Yakṣas</s>, one is freed from sins.
May I obtain the fulfillment I have desired, and may I be together with her.

children.text: evaṃ prasādya yakṣendraṃ tataḥ pañcanadaṃ vrajet // VamPSm_13.26 //
children.translated_text: Having thus propitiated the lord of <s>Yakṣas</s>, one should then proceed to <s>Pañcanada</s>. // VamPSm 13.26 //
The five rivers were created by <s>Rudra</s>, terrifying to the <s>Dānavas</s>.

children.text: tatra sarveṣu lokeṣu tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ smṛtam // VamPSm_13.27 //
children.translated_text: There, in all the worlds, the <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford) called <s>Pañcanada</s> is renowned. // VamPSm 13.27 //
Because <s>Rudra</s> gathered together a <s>koṭi</s> (ten million) of <s>tīrthas</s> and established them there,
therefore it is proclaimed as <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, famous in the three worlds. // VamPSm 13.28 //

children.text: tasmin tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ haram /
children.translated_text: A man who bathes in that <s>tīrtha</s> and beholds <s>Koṭīśvara Hara</s>,
constantly endowed with faith, obtains the fruit of the five sacrifices. // VamPSm 13.29 //
There too, the god <s>Vāmana</s> was installed by all the gods.

children.text: tatrāpi ca naraḥ snātvā hyagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet // VamPSm_13.30 //
children.translated_text: Having bathed there too, a man obtains the fruit of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> (fire-sacrifice). // VamPSm 13.30 //
Having reached the <s>tīrtha</s> of the <s>Aśvins</s>, one who is faithful and has conquered the senses

children.text: rūpasya bhāgī bhavati yaśasvī ca bhavennaraḥ // VamPSm_13.31 //
children.translated_text: becomes a sharer of beauty and a man of renown. // VamPSm 13.31 //
The <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Vārāha</s> was proclaimed by <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: tasmin snātvā śraddadhānaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_13.32 //
children.translated_text: Having bathed there with faith, one attains the supreme state. // VamPSm 13.32 //
Then one should proceed, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, to the supreme <s>Somatīrtha</s>,
where <s>Soma</s>, having performed austerities, was formerly freed from disease. // VamPSm 13.33 //

children.text: tatra someśvare dṛṣṭvā snātvā tīrthavare śubhe /
children.translated_text: Having beheld <s>Someśvara</s> and having bathed in that excellent and auspicious <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ // VamPSm_13.34 //
children.translated_text: a man obtains the fruit of the <s>Rājasūya</s> sacrifice. // VamPSm 13.34 //
Freed from diseases and devoid of all faults,
he attains the world of <s>Soma</s> and rejoices there for a long time. // VamPSm 13.35 //
There too are <s>Bhūteśvara</s> and <s>Jvālāmāleśvara</s>;

children.text: tāvubhau liṅgāvabhyarcya na bhūyo janma cāpnuyāt // VamPSm_13.36 //
children.translated_text: having worshipped both those <s>liṅgas</s>, one does not obtain rebirth again. // VamPSm 13.36 //
Having bathed at <s>Ekahaṃsa</s>, a man obtains the fruit of (giving) a thousand cows.
Having reached <s>Kṛtaśoca</s>, a best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s> devoted to <s>tīrthas</s>, // VamPSm 13.37 //
obtains (the merit of) the <s>Puṇḍarīka</s> (sacrifice); one who has performed ablutions at <s>Kṛkaśauca</s> becomes (purified).

children.text: tato muñjavaṭaṃ nāma mahādevasya dhīmataḥ // VamPSm_13.38 //
children.translated_text: Then (one should go to) the place called <s>Muñjavaṭa</s>, belonging to the wise <s>Mahādeva</s>. // VamPSm 13.38 //
Having fasted for one night, one would obtain the status of being a follower of <s>Gaṇeśa</s> (<s>gāṇapatya</s>).

children.text: tatraiva ca mahāgrāhī yakṣiṇī lokaviśrutā // VamPSm_13.39 //
children.translated_text: And there too is the great seizing <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>, renowned in the world. // VamPSm 13.39 //
Having bathed there and having gone (to her), having propitiated the <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>,
and (performing) a fast there, which destroys great sins — // VamPSm 13.40 //
that is the gate of <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, renowned as increasing merit.
Having circumambulated it, one should then feed <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.

children.text: puṣkaraṃ ca tato gatvā abhyarcya pitṛdevatāḥ // VamPSm_13.41 //
children.translated_text: Then having gone to <s>Puṣkara</s>, having worshipped the ancestral deities — // VamPSm 13.41 //
that (place) was brought forth by <s>Rāma</s> son of <s>Jamadagni</s>, that great soul.

children.text: kṛtakṛtyo bhaved rājā aśvamedhaṃ ca vindati // VamPSm_13.42 //
children.translated_text: A king becomes one who has fulfilled his purpose and obtains (the fruit of) the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse-sacrifice). // VamPSm 13.42 //

children.text: kanyādānaṃ ca yastatra kārtikyāṃ vai kariṣyati /
children.translated_text: And one who shall give a maiden in marriage there on the <s>Kārttikī</s> (full moon of Kārttika),
the gods, being pleased with him, will grant the desired fruit. // VamPSm 13.43 //
<s>Kapala</s>, the great <s>Yakṣa</s>, stands as the gate-guardian.

children.text: vighnaṃ karoti pāpānāṃ durgati ca prayacchati // VamPSm_13.44 //
children.translated_text: He creates obstacles for the sinful and bestows upon them a miserable fate. // VamPSm 13.44 //
His wife is the great <s>Yakṣī</s> named <s>Udūkhalamekhalā</s>.

children.text: āhatya dundubhiṃ tatra bhramate nityameva hi // VamPSm_13.45 //
children.translated_text: Striking a drum there, she wanders about constantly. // VamPSm 13.45 //

children.text: sā dadarśa striyaṃ caikāṃ saputrāṃ pāpadeśajām /
children.translated_text: She saw a certain woman with her son, born in a sinful land.

children.text: tāmuvāca tadā yakṣī āhatya niśi dundubhim // VamPSm_13.46 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Yakṣī</s> then spoke to her, striking the drum in the night: // VamPSm 13.46 //
'Having eaten curd at <s>Yugandhara</s>, and having stayed at <s>Acyutasthala</s>,

children.text: tadvad bhūtālaye snātvā saputrā vastumicchasi // VamPSm_13.47 //
children.translated_text: and likewise having bathed at <s>Bhūtālaya</s>, do you wish to dwell here with your son? // VamPSm 13.47 //

children.text: divā mayā te kathitaṃ rātrau bhakṣyāmi niścitam /
children.translated_text: By day I have told you; at night I shall certainly devour you.'

children.text: etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ praṇipatya ca yakṣiṇīm // VamPSm_13.48 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this speech and having bowed down to the <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>, // VamPSm 13.48 //

children.text: uvāca dīnayā vācā prasādaṃ kuru bhāmini /
children.translated_text: she said in a piteous voice: 'Be gracious, O beautiful one!'

children.text: tataḥ sā yakṣiṇī tāṃ tu provāca kṛpayānvitā // VamPSm_13.49 //
children.translated_text: Then that <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>, filled with compassion, said to her: // VamPSm 13.49 //

children.text: yadā sūryasya grahaṇaṃ kālena bhavitā kvacit /
children.translated_text: 'Whenever there shall be a solar eclipse at some time,

children.text: saṃnihatyāṃ tadā snātvā pūtā svargaṃ kamiṣyasi // VamPSm_13.50 //
children.translated_text: then, having bathed at <s>Saṃnihitī</s>, you shall be purified and go to heaven.' // VamPSm 13.50 //
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter of the <s>Saromāhātmya</s> in the <s>Vāmanapurāṇa</s>.
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
Then the best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, devoted to <s>tīrthas</s>, should go to <s>Rāmahrada</s>,

children.text: yatra rāmeṇa vipreṇa tarasā dīptatejasā // VamPSm_14.1 //
children.translated_text: where by the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> <s>Rāma</s>, blazing with splendor and mighty valor, // VamPSm 14.1 //
having destroyed the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, five pools were established,

children.text: pūrayitvā naravyāghra rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam // VamPSm_14.2 //
children.translated_text: having filled them, O tiger among men, with blood — so we have heard. // VamPSm 14.2 //
The ancestors and grandfathers were satiated by him.
Then those ancestors, pleased, spoke to <s>Rāma</s>, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>: // VamPSm 14.3 //

children.text: rāma rāma mahābāho prītāḥ smastava bhārgava /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Rāma</s>, O <s>Rāma</s>, O mighty-armed one, we are pleased, O son of <s>Bhṛgu</s>,

children.text: anayā pitṛbhaktyā ca vikrameṇa ca te vibho // VamPSm_14.4 //
children.translated_text: by this devotion to ancestors and by your valor, O lord! // VamPSm 14.4 //

children.text: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te kimicchasi mahāyaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Choose a boon — may you prosper! What do you desire, O greatly renowned one?'

children.text: evamuktastu pitṛbhī rāmaḥ prabhavatāḥ paraḥ // VamPSm_14.5 //
children.translated_text: Thus addressed by the ancestors, <s>Rāma</s>, supreme among the mighty, // VamPSm 14.5 //

children.text: abravīt prāñjalirvākyaṃ sa pitṛn gagane sthitān /
children.translated_text: spoke with folded hands to the ancestors stationed in the sky:

children.text: bhavanto yadi me prītā yadya nugrāhyatā mayi // VamPSm_14.6 //
children.translated_text: 'If you are pleased with me, if grace is to be bestowed upon me, // VamPSm 14.6 //
by the grace of the ancestors, I wish for the restoration of my austerity;
and may I be freed from the sin of having destroyed the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, overwhelmed by wrath. // VamPSm 14.7 //
May I be freed from that sin by your splendor,
and may these pools become <s>tīrthas</s>, renowned on earth.' // VamPSm 14.8 //
Thus addressed with auspicious words by <s>Rāma</s>, the ancestors then,
supremely pleased, filled with joy, replied to <s>Rāma</s>: // VamPSm 14.9 //
'May your austerity increase, O son, especially through your devotion to ancestors!
And as for the <s>Kṣatriyas</s> destroyed by you, overwhelmed by wrath — // VamPSm 14.10 //
you are freed from that sin; those (Kṣatriyas) were cast down by their own <s>karmas</s>.

children.text: hradāśca tava tīrthatvaṃ gamīṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_14.11 //
children.translated_text: And your pools shall attain the status of <s>tīrthas</s>, without doubt. // VamPSm 14.11 //

children.text: hradeṣveteṣu ye snātvā svān pitṝṃstarpayanti ca /
children.translated_text: Those who bathe in these pools and satiate their ancestors —

children.text: tebhyo dāsyanti pitaro yathābhilaṣitaṃ varam // VamPSm_14.12 //
children.translated_text: to them the ancestors will grant the desired boon. // VamPSm 14.12 //

children.text: īpsitān mānasān kāmān svargavāsaṃ ca śāśvatam /
children.translated_text: Desired wishes of the heart and eternal residence in heaven.'

children.text: evaṃ dattvā varān viprā rāmasya pitarastadā // VamPSm_14.13 //
children.translated_text: Having thus granted boons to <s>Rāma</s>, the ancestors, O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, // VamPSm 14.13 //
having taken leave of the son of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, pleased, disappeared right there.

children.text: evaṃ rāmahradāḥ puṇyā bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ // VamPSm_14.14 //
children.translated_text: Thus the holy pools of <s>Rāma</s>, of the great-souled son of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, (are sanctified). // VamPSm 14.14 //
Having bathed in the pools of <s>Rāma</s>, a celibate of pure vows,

children.text: rāmamabhyarcya śraddhāvān vinded bahu suvarṇakam // VamPSm_14.15 //
children.translated_text: having worshipped <s>Rāma</s> with faith, obtains abundant gold. // VamPSm 14.15 //
Having reached <s>Vaṃśamūla</s>, a self-controlled person devoted to <s>tīrthas</s>,

children.text: svavaṃśasiddhaye viprāḥ snātvā vai vaṃśamūlake // VamPSm_14.16 //
children.translated_text: O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, having bathed at <s>Vaṃśamūlaka</s>, (obtains) the perfection of his lineage. // VamPSm 14.16 //
Having reached <s>Kāyaśodhana</s>, a <s>tīrtha</s> renowned in the three worlds,
one who bathes there attains purification of the body, without doubt. // VamPSm 14.17 //
And with a purified body, one goes to that (state) from which there is no return.
<s>Siddhas</s> (perfected beings) devoted to <s>tīrthas</s> wander among the <s>tīrthas</s>
until they reach that <s>tīrtha</s> of body-purification (<s>Kāyaśodhana</s>). // VamPSm 14.18 //
Having immersed the body in that <s>tīrtha</s>, with a controlled mind,
one attains the supreme state from which there is no return.
Then one should proceed, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, to the <s>tīrtha</s> renowned in the three worlds, // VamPSm 14.19-20 //

children.text: lokā yatroddhatāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā // VamPSm_14.20 //
children.translated_text: where all the worlds were uplifted by the mighty <s>Viṣṇu</s>.
Having reached <s>Lokoddhāra</s>, intent on the remembrance of <s>tīrthas</s>,

children.text: snātvātīrthavare tasmin lokān paśyati śāśvatān // VamPSm_14.21 //
children.translated_text: having bathed in that excellent <s>tīrtha</s>, one beholds the eternal worlds. // VamPSm 14.21 //

children.text: yatra viṣṇuḥ sthito nityaṃ śivo devaḥ sanātanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Where <s>Viṣṇu</s> abides eternally, (and) the eternal god <s>Śiva</s> —

children.text: tau devau praṇipātena prasādya muktimāpnuyāt // VamPSm_14.22 //
children.translated_text: by prostrating to those two gods and propitiating them, one attains liberation. // VamPSm 14.22 //
Then one should go to <s>Śrītīrtha</s>, the supreme <s>Śālagrāma</s>.

children.text: tatra snātasya sānnidhyaṃ sadā devī prayacchati // VamPSm_14.23 //
children.translated_text: The goddess always grants her proximity to one who bathes there. // VamPSm 14.23 //
Having reached <s>Kapilāhrada</s>, a <s>tīrtha</s> renowned in the three worlds,

children.text: tatra snātvār'cayitvā ca daivatāni pitṛstathā // VamPSm_14.24 //
children.translated_text: having bathed there and having worshipped the gods and ancestors, // VamPSm 14.24 //
a man obtains the fruit of (giving) a thousand tawny cows.

children.text: tatra sthitaṃ mahādevaṃ kāpilaṃ vapurāsthitam // VamPSm_14.25 //
children.translated_text: The great god <s>Śiva</s> abides there, having assumed the form of <s>Kapila</s>. // VamPSm 14.25 //
Having beheld <s>Śiva</s>, worshipped by the <s>ṛṣis</s>, one attains liberation.
Having reached <s>Sūryatīrtha</s> and having bathed there with a disciplined mind, // VamPSm 14.26 //
having worshipped the ancestors and gods, devoted to fasting,
one obtains (the fruit of) the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> and goes to the world of <s>Sūrya</s>. // VamPSm 14.27 //
Having beheld the god of a thousand rays, <s>Bhānu</s> (the Sun), renowned in the three worlds,
a man endowed with knowledge attains liberation. // VamPSm 14.28 //
Having reached <s>Bhavānīvana</s>, a <s>tīrtha</s>-seeker, in due order,
performing ablutions there, obtains the fruit of (giving) a thousand cows. // VamPSm 14.29 //
When the Grandfather (<s>Brahmā</s>) was drinking <s>amṛta</s> (nectar) in ancient times,

children.text: udgārāt surabhirjātā sā ca pātālamāśritā // VamPSm_14.30 //
children.translated_text: from his eructation <s>Surabhī</s> (the wish-fulfilling cow) was born; and she took refuge in <s>Pātāla</s> (the netherworld). // VamPSm 14.30 //
From her were born the fragrant ones (<s>Surabhīs</s>), her daughters, the mothers of the world.
By them that entire <s>Pātāla</s> was pervaded, without any gap. // VamPSm 14.31 //
They were brought as the sacrificial fee for the Grandfather's sacrifice.

children.text: āhutā brahmaṇā tāśca vibhrāntā vivareṇa hi // VamPSm_14.32 //
children.translated_text: Summoned by <s>Brahmā</s>, they came through a crevice, bewildered. // VamPSm 14.32 //

children.text: tasmin vivaradvāre tu sthito gaṇapatiḥ svayam /
children.translated_text: At the opening of that crevice, <s>Gaṇapati</s> himself stands.

children.text: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakalān kāmān prāpnotisaṃyatendriyaḥ // VamPSm_14.33 //
children.translated_text: Having beheld him, one of controlled senses obtains all desires. // VamPSm 14.33 //
Having reached <s>Saṃginī</s>, a <s>tīrtha</s> that is the resort of liberation,

children.text: devyāstīrthe naraḥ snātvā labhate rūpamuttamam // VamPSm_14.34 //
children.translated_text: a man who bathes in the <s>tīrtha</s> of the goddess obtains supreme beauty. // VamPSm 14.34 //
He attains endless prosperity, accompanied by sons and grandsons,

children.text: bhogāṃśca vipulān bhuktvā prāpnoti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_14.35 //
children.translated_text: and having enjoyed abundant pleasures, he attains the supreme state. // VamPSm 14.35 //
A man who bathes at <s>Brahmāvarta</s>, endowed with knowledge of <s>Brahman</s>,

children.text: bhavate nātra sandehaḥ prāṇān muñcati svecchayā // VamPSm_14.36 //
children.translated_text: becomes (liberated) — there is no doubt about this — and gives up his life-breaths at will. // VamPSm 14.36 //

children.text: tato gaccheta viprendrā dvārapālaṃ tu rantukam /
children.translated_text: Then one should proceed, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, to the gate-guardian <s>Rantuka</s>.

children.text: tasya tīrthaṃ sarasvatyāṃ yakṣendrasya mahātmanaḥ // VamPSm_14.37 //
children.translated_text: His <s>tīrtha</s> is on the <s>Sarasvatī</s>, (the <s>tīrtha</s>) of the great-souled lord of <s>Yakṣas</s>. // VamPSm 14.37 //
Having bathed there, O greatly wise one, devoted to fasting,

children.text: yakṣasya ca prasādena labhate kāmikaṃ phalam // VamPSm_14.38 //
children.translated_text: by the grace of the <s>Yakṣa</s>, one obtains the desired fruit. // VamPSm 14.38 //
Then one should proceed, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, to <s>Brahmāvarta</s>, praised by sages.

children.text: brahmāvarte naraḥ snātvā brahma cāpnoti niścitam // VamPSm_14.39 //
children.translated_text: A man who bathes at <s>Brahmāvarta</s> certainly attains <s>Brahman</s>. // VamPSm 14.39 //
Then one should proceed, O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, to the supreme <s>Sutīrthaka</s>.

children.text: tatra saṃnihitā nityaṃ pitaro daivataiḥ saha // VamPSm_14.40 //
children.translated_text: There the ancestors are always present together with the gods. // VamPSm 14.40 //
One should perform ablutions there, devoted to the worship of ancestors and gods.
One obtains (the fruit of) the <s>Aśvamedha</s> and pleases the ancestors eternally. // VamPSm 14.41 //
Then, O knower of <s>dharma</s>, having reached <s>Ambuvana</s> in due order,

children.text: kāmeśvarasya tīrthaṃ tu snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ // VamPSm_14.42 //
children.translated_text: having bathed at the <s>tīrtha</s> of <s>Kāmeśvara</s>, endowed with faith, // VamPSm 14.42 //
one becomes freed from all diseases, and the attainment of <s>Brahman</s> is certain.

children.text: mātṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva yatra snātasya bhaktitaḥ // VamPSm_14.43 //
children.translated_text: And there too is the <s>Mātṛtīrtha</s>, where one who bathes with devotion — // VamPSm 14.43 //
his progeny increases constantly, and he attains endless prosperity.
Then one should go to <s>Śītavana</s>, self-controlled and of regulated diet. // VamPSm 14.44 //
There, O great <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, is a <s>tīrtha</s> that is great and rare elsewhere.

children.text: punāti darśanādeva daṇḍakaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ // VamPSm_14.45 //
children.translated_text: It purifies by mere sight, and (it purifies) the <s>Daṇḍaka</s> (forest), O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>. // VamPSm 14.45 //

children.text: keśānabhyukṣya vai tasmin pūto bhavati pāpataḥ /
children.translated_text: Having sprinkled one's hair in it, one becomes purified from sin.

children.text: tatra tīrthavaraṃ cānyat svānulomāyanaṃ mahat // VamPSm_14.46 //
children.translated_text: And there is another excellent <s>tīrtha</s> there, the great <s>Svānulomāyana</s>. // VamPSm 14.46 //
There, O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, the greatly wise and learned ones, devoted to <s>tīrthas</s>,
at the <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford) of <s>Svanulomāyana</s>, renowned in the three worlds, O <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,
the best of twice-born ones remove their body hair through <s>prāṇāyāma</s> (breath-control exercises);

children.text: pūtātmānaśca te viprāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim // VamPSm_14.48 //
children.translated_text: and those <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, having purified their souls, attain the supreme destination.
There is also a well-known <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Daśāśvamedhika</s> (of ten horse-sacrifices);

children.text: tatra snātvā bhaktiyuktastadeva labhate phalam // VamPSm_14.49 //
children.translated_text: one who bathes there with devotion obtains that very fruit [of ten <s>Aśvamedha</s> sacrifices].
Then one should go with faith to [the <s>tīrtha</s>] called <s>Mānuṣa</s>, renowned in the world;

children.text: darśanāt tasya tīrthasya mukto bhavati kilbiṣaiḥ // VamPSm_14.50 //
children.translated_text: by merely seeing that <s>tīrtha</s>, one is freed from sins.
Formerly, black deer there, pierced by a hunter's arrows,
plunged into that lake and attained human form.

children.text: tato vyādhāśca te sarve tānapṛcchan dvijottamān /
children.translated_text: Then all those hunters asked those best of twice-born ones:

children.text: mṛgā anena vai yātā asmābhiḥ śarapīḍitāḥ // VamPSm_14.52 //
children.translated_text: 'The deer that were pierced by our arrows have gone this way;

children.text: nimagnāste saraḥ prāpya kva te yātā dvijottamāḥ /
children.translated_text: having plunged into this lake, where have they gone, O best of twice-born ones?'

children.text: te 'bruvaṃstatra vai pṛṣṭā vayaṃ te ca dvijottamāḥ // VamPSm_14.53 //
children.translated_text: Those who were asked there said: 'We are those very [deer], O best of twice-born ones;
through the greatness of this <s>tīrtha</s>, we have attained human form.

children.text: tasmād yūyaṃ śraddadhānāḥ snātvā tīrthe vimatsarāḥ // VamPSm_14.54 //
children.translated_text: Therefore, you too, being faithful and free from envy, having bathed in this <s>tīrtha</s>,
will become freed from all sins — there is no doubt.'

children.text: tataḥ snātāśca te sarve śuddhadehā divaṃ gatāḥ // VamPSm_14.55 //
children.translated_text: Then all of them, having bathed, with purified bodies, went to heaven.
This is the greatness of the <s>tīrtha</s> of <s>Mānuṣa</s>, O best of twice-born ones;

children.text: ye śṛṇvanti śraddadhānāste 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim // VamPSm_14.56 //
children.translated_text: those who hear it with faith also attain the supreme destination.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter of the <s>Saromāhātmya</s> in the glorious <s>Vāmanapurāṇa</s>.
<s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s> said:
To the east of <s>Mānuṣa</s>, at a distance of one <s>krośa</s> (about two miles), O best of twice-born ones,

children.text: āpagā nāma vikhyātā nadī dvijaniṣevitā // VamPSm_15.1 //
children.translated_text: there is the famous river called <s>Āpagā</s>, frequented by the twice-born.
Those who offer to <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> millet cooked with milk and drenched with ghee —

children.text: ye prayacchanti viprebhyasteṣāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate // VamPSm_15.2 //
children.translated_text: no sin exists for them.

children.text: ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti prāpya tāmāpagāṃ nadīm /
children.translated_text: Those who perform <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) having reached that river <s>Āpagā</s>,

children.text: te sarvakāmasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_15.3 //
children.translated_text: they will be endowed with all desires — there is no doubt.

children.text: śaṃsanti sarve pitaraḥ smaranti ca pitāmahāḥ /
children.translated_text: All the ancestors praise and the grandfathers remember [saying]:

children.text: asmākaṃ ca kule putraḥ pautro vāpi bhaviṣyati // VamPSm_15.4 //
children.translated_text: 'In our family there will be a son or a grandson

children.text: ya āpagāṃ nadīṃ gatvā tilaiḥ saṃtarpayiṣyati /
children.translated_text: who, having gone to the river <s>Āpagā</s>, will satisfy [us] with sesame seeds;

children.text: tena tṛptā bhaviṣyāmo yāvatkalpaśataṃ gatam // VamPSm_15.5 //
children.translated_text: by him we will be satisfied for a hundred <s>kalpas</s> (cosmic ages).'
When the month of <s>Nabhasya</s> (Bhādrapada) arrives, especially in the dark fortnight,

children.text: caturdaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne piṇḍado muktimāpnuyāt // VamPSm_15.6 //
children.translated_text: one who offers <s>piṇḍas</s> (rice-balls for the dead) on the fourteenth [day] at midday attains liberation.
Then one should go, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, to the supreme place of <s>Brahmā</s>,
known as <s>Brahmodumbara</s>, famous in all the worlds.
For one who has bathed in the pools of <s>Brahmarṣi</s> (Brahman-sages) there, O best of twice-born ones,
by the grace of the <s>Saptarṣis</s> (Seven Sages), the fruit of seven <s>Soma</s> sacrifices is obtained.
<s>Bharadvāja</s>, <s>Gautama</s>, <s>Jamadagni</s>, <s>Kaśyapa</s>,
<s>Viśvāmitra</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, and the venerable sage <s>Atri</s> —

children.text: etaiḥ sametya tatkuṇḍaṃ kalpitaṃ bhuvi durlabham /
children.translated_text: by these [sages], assembled together, that pool was created, rare on earth;
since it was frequented by <s>Brahmā</s>, it is called <s>Brahmodumbara</s>.
One who has bathed in that excellent <s>tīrtha</s> of <s>Brahmā</s>, whose birth is unmanifest,
attains the world of <s>Brahmā</s> — there need be no deliberation on this.

children.text: devān pitṝn samuddiśya yo vipraṃ bhojayiṣyati /
children.translated_text: One who feeds a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> there, dedicating [the merit] to the gods and ancestors —

children.text: pitarastasya sukhitā dāsyanti bhuvi durlabham // VamPSm_15.12 //
children.translated_text: his ancestors, being pleased, will grant what is rare on earth.
One who, dedicating [the merit] to the <s>Saptarṣis</s> (Seven Sages), performs bathing separately —

children.text: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca prasādena saptalokādhipo bhavet // VamPSm_15.13 //
children.translated_text: by the grace of the sages, he becomes lord of the seven worlds.
[The place] known as <s>Kapisthala</s>, which destroys all sins,

children.text: yasmin sthitaḥ khayaṃ devo vṛddhakedārasaṃjñitaḥ // VamPSm_15.14 //
children.translated_text: where the deity resides, known as <s>Vṛddhakeḍāra</s> (Old <s>Kedāra</s>) —
one who bathes there and worships <s>Rudra</s> together with <s>Diṇḍi</s>,
attains disappearance [from the cycle of rebirth] and rejoices in the world of <s>Śiva</s>.
One who, having performed <s>tarpaṇa</s> (libation) there, drinks three handfuls of water,

children.text: diṇḍidevaṃ namaskṛtya kedārasya phalaṃ labhet // VamPSm_15.16 //
children.translated_text: and bows to the deity <s>Diṇḍi</s>, obtains the fruit of [visiting] <s>Kedāra</s>.
A person who performs <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) there, dedicating [them] to <s>Śiva</s>,
on the fourteenth of the bright half of <s>Caitra</s>, attains the supreme abode.

children.text: kalasyāṃ tu tato gacched yatra devī svayaṃ sthitā /
children.translated_text: Then one should go to <s>Kalasyā</s>, where the goddess herself resides —

children.text: durgā kātyāyanī bhadrā nidrā māyā sanātanī // VamPSm_15.18 //
children.translated_text: <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Kātyāyanī</s>, <s>Bhadrā</s>, <s>Nidrā</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, the eternal one.

children.text: kalasyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā durgā taṭe sthitām /
children.translated_text: A person who bathes in <s>Kalasyā</s> and sees <s>Durgā</s> standing on the bank
crosses the impassable thicket of <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence) — there is no doubt.
Then one should go to <s>Saraka</s>, [a place] rare even for the three worlds;

children.text: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram // VamPSm_15.20 //
children.translated_text: having seen lord <s>Maheśvara</s> on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight,
one obtains all desires and goes to the world of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: tisrāḥ koṭyastu tīrthānāṃ sarake dvijasattamāḥ // VamPSm_15.21 //
children.translated_text: There are three <s>koṭis</s> (tens of millions) of <s>tīrthas</s> at <s>Saraka</s>, O best of twice-born ones;
and a <s>Rudrakoṭi</s> (ten million <s>Rudras</s>) is established in a well in the middle of the lake.

children.text: tasmin sare ca yaḥ snātvā rudrakoṭiṃ smarennaraḥ // VamPSm_15.22 //
children.translated_text: A person who, having bathed in that lake, contemplates the <s>Rudrakoṭi</s>,
will have worshipped the <s>Rudrakoṭi</s> — there is no doubt;
and by the grace of the <s>Rudras</s>, freed from all faults,
endowed with the knowledge of <s>Indra</s>, he attains the supreme abode.

children.text: iḍāspadaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ pāpabhayāpaham // VamPSm_15.24 //
children.translated_text: And there also is the <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Iḍāspada</s>, which dispels the fear of sin;
at this [place], a person attains liberation merely by seeing it.
One who, having bathed there, worships the hosts of ancestors and gods —
does not attain misfortune and obtains whatever is desired by the mind.
And <s>Kedāra</s>, the great <s>tīrtha</s>, which destroys all defilements —

children.text: tatra snātvā tu puruṣaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet /
children.translated_text: a person who bathes there obtains the fruit of all gifts.

children.text: kiṃrūpaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ tatraiva bhuvi durlabham // VamPSm_15.27 //
children.translated_text: And <s>Kiṃrūpa</s>, the great <s>tīrtha</s>, rare on earth, is also there;
to the east of <s>Saraka</s> is the <s>tīrtha</s> renowned in the three worlds,
well-known as <s>Anyajanma</s> (Other Birth), which destroys all sins.
<s>Viṣṇu</s>, having assumed the form of <s>Narasiṃha</s> (man-lion) and having slain the mighty demon,

children.text: tiryagyonau sthito viṣṇuḥ siṃheṣu ratimāpnuvan // VamPSm_15.29 //
children.translated_text: remained in an animal birth, delighting among lions.

children.text: tato devāḥ sagandharvā ārāghya varadaṃ śivam /
children.translated_text: Then the gods together with the <s>Gandharvas</s>, having worshipped the boon-granting <s>Śiva</s>,
spoke with all limbs bowed, regarding the recovery of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s body.
Then that great-souled god assumed the form of <s>Śarabha</s>,
and caused a divine battle lasting a thousand years;

children.text: yudhyamānau tu tau devau patitau saramadhyataḥ // VamPSm_15.31 //
children.translated_text: and those two gods, while fighting, fell into the middle of the lake.
On the bank of that lake, the divine sage <s>Nārada</s>, a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, was stationed,
seated under an <s>Aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) tree, absorbed in meditation, and he beheld [the scene].
<s>Viṣṇu</s> was born [again] with four arms, and <s>Śiva</s> stood in the form of a <s>liṅga</s>;

children.text: tau dṛṣṭvā tatra puruṣau tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvitaḥ // VamPSm_15.33 //
children.translated_text: seeing those two persons there, [<s>Nārada</s>], filled with devotion, praised [them]:
'Salutation to <s>Śiva</s>, the god, to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the powerful one,

children.text: haraye ca umābhartre sthitikālabhṛte namaḥ // VamPSm_15.34 //
children.translated_text: to <s>Hari</s> and to the husband of <s>Umā</s>; salutation to the bearer of creation, preservation, and destruction.'
'To <s>Hara</s>, the many-formed, to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the all-formed,
to the three-eyed one, the supremely pure, to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the cause of knowledge.'

children.text: dhanyo 'haṃ sukṛtī nityaṃ yad dṛṣṭo puruṣottamau /
children.translated_text: 'Blessed am I, ever meritorious, that I have seen the two supreme persons.
My hermitage has been purified by you two.
From this day forth, it shall be known in the three worlds as <s>Anyajanma</s> (Other Birth).'

children.text: ya ihāgatya snātvā ca pitṝn saṃtarpayiṣyati /
children.translated_text: 'One who comes here, bathes, and satisfies the ancestors —
for that faithful person, the knowledge of <s>Indra</s> shall be [attained].'

children.text: aśvatthasya tu yanmūlaṃ sadā tatra vasāmyaham /
children.translated_text: 'At the root of this <s>Aśvattha</s> tree I shall always dwell;

children.text: aśvatthavandanaṃ kṛtvā yamaṃ raudraṃ na paśyati // VamPSm_15.38 //
children.translated_text: one who reverences the <s>Aśvattha</s> tree shall not see terrifying <s>Yama</s> (god of death).'
Then one should go, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, to the excellent lake of the <s>Nāga</s> (serpent);

children.text: pauṇḍarīke naraḥ snātvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet // VamPSm_15.39 //
children.translated_text: a person who bathes in <s>Pauṇḍarīka</s> obtains the fruit of [the sacrifice called] <s>Puṇḍarīka</s>.
On the tenth of the bright half, especially of <s>Caitra</s>,

children.text: snānaṃ japaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ muktimārgapradāyakam // VamPSm_15.40 //
children.translated_text: bathing, <s>japa</s> (recitation), and <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) grant the path of liberation.
Then one should go to <s>Triviṣṭava</s>, a <s>tīrtha</s> frequented by the gods;

children.text: tatra vaitaraṇī puṇyā nadī pāpapramocanī // VamPSm_15.41 //
children.translated_text: there flows the sacred river <s>Vaitaraṇī</s>, which releases one from sin.
One who bathes there and worships the trident-bearing, bull-bannered [<s>Śiva</s>],
with soul purified of all sins, indeed attains the supreme destination.
Then one should go, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, to the excellent <s>Rasāvarta</s>;
one who bathes there with devotion attains unsurpassed perfection.
One who bathes at the <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Alepaka</s> on the fourteenth of the bright half of <s>Caitra</s>,

children.text: pūjayitvā śivaṃ tatra pāpalepo na vidyate // VamPSm_15.44 //
children.translated_text: and worships <s>Śiva</s> there — no stain of sin exists [for him].
Then one should go, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, to the excellent <s>Phalakīvana</s> (forest of the Phalakī tree),

children.text: yatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ /
children.translated_text: where gods together with <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, and sages reside
and perform great austerity for a thousand divine years.

children.text: dṛṣadvatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā tarpayitvā ca devatāḥ /
children.translated_text: A person who bathes in the <s>Dṛṣadvatī</s> [river] and satisfies the deities
obtains the fruit of the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> and <s>Atirātra</s> sacrifices.

children.text: somakṣaye ca saṃprāpte somasya ca dine tathā /
children.translated_text: When the <s>Somakṣaya</s> (lunar eclipse) arrives, and on the day of <s>Soma</s> (Monday),

children.text: yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute martyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu // VamPSm_15.47 //
children.translated_text: hear the meritorious fruit of one who performs <s>śrāddha</s>:

children.text: gayāyāṃ ca yatā śrāddha pitṛn prīṇāti nityaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: just as performing <s>śrāddha</s> at <s>Gayā</s> gratifies the ancestors perpetually,

children.text: tathā śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ phalakīvanamāśritaiḥ // VamPSm_15.48 //
children.translated_text: so too should <s>śrāddha</s> be performed by those who have resorted to <s>Phalakīvana</s>.
Even one who merely remembers the excellent <s>Phalakīvana</s> in mind —

children.text: tasyāpi pitarastṛptiṃ prayāsyanti na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_15.49 //
children.translated_text: his ancestors too will attain satisfaction, there is no doubt.
There too is a great <s>tīrtha</s>, adorned by all the gods;

children.text: tasmin snātastu puruṣo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet // VamPSm_15.50 //
children.translated_text: a person who bathes in it obtains the fruit of [giving] a thousand cows.

children.text: pāṇikhāte naraḥ snātvā pitṛn saṃtarpya mānavaḥ /
children.translated_text: A person who bathes at <s>Pāṇikhāta</s> (hand-dug well) and satisfies the ancestors

children.text: avāpnuyād rājasūyaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca vindati // VamPSm_15.51 //
children.translated_text: attains [the merit of] the <s>Rājasūya</s> sacrifice and gains <s>Sāṅkhya</s> and <s>Yoga</s> [knowledge].
Then one should go to the great and excellent <s>tīrtha</s> called <s>Miśraka</s>;

children.text: tatra tīrthāni muninā miśritāni mahātmanā // VamPSm_15.52 //
children.translated_text: there, <s>tīrthas</s> were mixed together by the great-souled sage
<s>Vyāsa</s>, tiger among sages, for the sake of the great-souled <s>Dadhīci</s>.

children.text: sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāti miśrake snāti yo naraḥ // VamPSm_15.53 //
children.translated_text: One who bathes at <s>Miśraka</s> bathes in all <s>tīrthas</s>.
Then one should go to <s>Vyāsavana</s> (the forest of <s>Vyāsa</s>), disciplined and with controlled diet;

children.text: manojave naraḥ snātvā miśrake snāti yo naraḥ // VamPSm_15.54 //
children.translated_text: a person who bathes at <s>Manojava</s> bathes at <s>Miśraka</s>.

children.text: manasā cintitaṃ sarvaṃ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Everything desired in mind is accomplished — there is no doubt.

children.text: gatvā madhuvaṭīṃ caiva devyāstīrthaṃ naraḥ śuciḥ // VamPSm_15.55 //
children.translated_text: Having gone to <s>Madhuvaṭī</s>, a pure person [should visit] the <s>tīrtha</s> of the Goddess.

children.text: tatra snātvār'cayed devān pitṝṃśca prayato naraḥ /
children.translated_text: One who bathes there and worships the gods and ancestors with devotion —

children.text: sa devyā samanujñāto yathā siddhiṃ labhennaraḥ // VamPSm_15.56 //
children.translated_text: that person, with the approval of the Goddess, obtains perfection.
The best of men who, at the confluence of the <s>Kauśikī</s> and <s>Dṛṣadvatī</s>,
bathes with controlled diet, is freed from all sins.

children.text: tato vyāsasthalī nāma yatra vyāsena dhīmatā /
children.translated_text: Then [there is a place] called <s>Vyāsasthalī</s> (the ground of <s>Vyāsa</s>), where the wise <s>Vyāsa</s>,
overcome by grief for his son, resolved to abandon his body.
He was raised up again by the gods, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>;

children.text: abhigamya sthalīṃ tasya putraśokaṃ na vindati // VamPSm_15.59 //
children.translated_text: by visiting that ground of his, one does not experience grief for a son.
Having reached the well of <s>Gindatta</s> and offering a <s>prastha</s> (measure) of sesame seeds,
one attains supreme perfection and obtains freedom from debts.

children.text: yahnaṃ ca sudinaṃ caiva dve tīrthe bhuvi durlabhe /
children.translated_text: <s>Yahna</s> and <s>Sudina</s> — two <s>tīrthas</s> rare on earth;
one who bathes at both, with purified soul, attains the world of <s>Sūrya</s> (the sun).

children.text: kṛtajapyaṃ tato gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
children.translated_text: Then one should go to <s>Kṛtajapya</s> (the place of performed prayer), renowned in the three worlds,

children.text: tatrābhiṣekaṃ kuvīnta gaṅgāyāṃ prayataḥ sthitaḥ // VamPSm_15.62 //
children.translated_text: There, having performed ablution in the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, standing with restrained senses, // VamPSm_15.62 //
having worshipped <s>Mahādeva</s>, one obtains the fruit of an <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice).

children.text: koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatraiva dṛṣṭvā koṭīśvaraṃ prabhum // VamPSm_15.63 //
children.translated_text: At that very place is <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, and having beheld Lord <s>Koṭīśvara</s>, // VamPSm_15.63 //
having bathed there with faith, one obtains the fruit of a <s>koṭi</s> (ten million) sacrifices.

children.text: tato vāmanakaṃ gacchet triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam // VamPSm_15.64 //
children.translated_text: Then one should go to <s>Vāmanaka</s>, renowned in the three worlds, // VamPSm_15.64 //
where, in the form of a <s>Vāmana</s> (dwarf), by the mighty <s>Viṣṇu</s>,
the kingdom was taken from <s>Bali</s> and restored to <s>Indra</s>. // VamPSm_15.65 //
Having bathed there at <s>Viṣṇupada</s> and having worshipped <s>Vāmana</s>,
with one's soul purified of all sins, one attains the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // VamPSm_15.66 //
At that very place is <s>Jyeṣṭhāśrama</s>, the destroyer of all sins.

children.text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā naro muktiṃ saṃprayāti na saṃśayaḥ // VamPSm_15.67 //
children.translated_text: Having beheld it, a man attains liberation — there is no doubt. // VamPSm_15.67 //
In the month of <s>Jyeṣṭha</s>, in the bright fortnight, having fasted on the <s>Ekādaśī</s>,

children.text: dvādaśyāṃ ca naraḥ snātvā jyeṣṭhatvaṃ labhate nṛpu // VamPSm_15.68 //
children.translated_text: and having bathed on the <s>Dvādaśī</s>, a man attains pre-eminence, O king. // VamPSm_15.68 //
There, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> were established by the mighty <s>Viṣṇu</s>,
endowed with consecration and installation, devoted to pleasing <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // VamPSm_15.69 //

children.text: tebhyo dattāni śrāddhāni dānāni vividhāni ca /
children.translated_text: The <s>śrāddhas</s> (ancestral offerings) and various gifts given to them
shall become imperishable, lasting as long as a <s>Manvantara</s> (age of Manu) endures. // VamPSm_15.70 //

children.text: tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
children.translated_text: At that very place is <s>Koṭitīrtha</s>, renowned in the three worlds.

children.text: tasmistīrthe naraḥ snātvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet // VamPSm_15.71 //
children.translated_text: Having bathed in that <s>tīrtha</s>, a man obtains the fruit of a <s>koṭi</s> (ten million) sacrifices. // VamPSm_15.71 //
Having beheld <s>Koṭīśvara</s>, the great lord <s>Maheśvara</s>, at that <s>tīrtha</s>,
by the grace of <s>Mahādeva</s>, one attains the status of a <s>Gaṇa</s> (attendant of Śiva). // VamPSm_16.72 //

children.text: tatraiva sumahat tīrthaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: At that very place is the great <s>tīrtha</s> of the noble <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun God).

children.text: tasmin snātvā bhaktibhuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate // VamPSm_15.73 //
children.translated_text: Having bathed there with devotion, one is honored in the world of <s>Sūrya</s>. // VamPSm_15.73 //
Then, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, one should go to the <s>tīrtha</s> that destroys sin,
named <s>Kulottāraṇa</s> (deliverance of the family), formerly established by <s>Viṣṇu</s>, // VamPSm_15.74 //
most pure, for the deliverance of all <s>varṇas</s> (castes) and <s>āśramas</s> (stages of life).
Even those who, through <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy), desire the supreme, pure <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation),

children.text: te 'pi tattīrthamāsādya paśyanti paramaṃ padam // VamPSm_15.75 //
children.translated_text: having reached that <s>tīrtha</s>, they behold the supreme abode. // VamPSm_15.75 //
A <s>brahmacārī</s> (celibate student), a <s>gṛhastha</s> (householder), a <s>vānaprastha</s> (forest-dweller), and likewise a <s>yati</s> (renunciant) —

children.text: kulāni tārayet snātaḥ sapta sapta ca sapta ca // VamPSm_15.76 //
children.translated_text: having bathed, each delivers seven and seven and seven generations of their family. // VamPSm_15.76 //

children.text: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sūdrā ye tatparāyaṇāḥ /
